text:
elaine-support: FYI ACME ticket INC-8821 — user reports 403 when switching into project 'prod-data' in the console after today's Okta migration. They can see org but project actions are blocked. Can oncall triage? :eyes:

michael-oncall: on it — can you drop repro steps + any screenshots or a curl reproducer?

elaine-support: screenshot uploaded https://files.acme/snap1.png 
Repro: SSO login -> org dropdown -> select 'ACME / prod-data' -> console shows 'You don't have access to this project' and most action buttons greyed out. No org role changes visible in console.

luis-cs: Customer says they moved user from Okta group 'engineering' -> 'data-team' around 09:12 UTC today. They think SCIM did that as part of the migration.

sam-eng-infra: I'll check provisioning + claim-mapping. Any network traces?

elaine-support: grabbed network trace. On switch the client calls GET /v1/projects/prod-data/permissions with Authorization: Bearer <access_token> -> 403. Repro with curl: 

  curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi..." "https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/prod-data/permissions"

Response: 403 Forbidden
{ "error": "forbidden", "reason": "insufficient_claims: groups missing" }

michael-oncall: that reason looks telling — idp might be trimming groups claim or not including role mapping in token. idp-bot: did SCIM/provisioning log anything?

idp-bot: provisioning: last SCIM sync 1765008000 SUCCESS; claim-mapping job last-run 1765007000 ERROR -> mapping failed: attribute 'groups' not found for some users (Okta attribute rename). See /infra/prov/logs/1765007000.

sam-eng-infra: sounds like tokens from SSO lack the groups claim so backend can't build project role set. Short-term workaround: we can attach project-level role via admin API to the affected user ID so they can continue (we'll add them to project-admin/data-editor) — but need user_id.

elaine-support: user_id is okta|12345678, I've updated the ticket with that and note that customer is OK with temporary grant.

sam-eng-infra: I'll re-run claim-mapping and provision job after patching the attribute mapping. ETA 30m. Also adding a small guard in permissions-checker: if groups claim missing, fall back to SCIM membership lookup for 24 hours.

michael-oncall: assigning to eng-infra, tagging @sam-eng-infra. I'll update the ticket with the temporary admin grant steps and mitigation instructions (log-out/log-in after we re-provision).

luis-cs: customer confirmed they received console access after temporary grant, will remove once fix validated. :lock:

elaine-support: marking as escalated -> eng-infra, adding links to logs + curl trace in ticket. Will follow up when mapping job completes.

sam-eng-infra: done — mapping job re-run successful at 1765011200, provisioning applied, groups claim present in new tokens. Please ask user to hard-refresh and re-login. last check: permissions endpoint returns 200 for that user.

elaine-support: great, closing loop with customer and documenting root cause: Okta attribute rename caused claim-mapping failure -> groups claim absent -> permissions resolution returned 403. We'll add a short KB about SSO migrations + token claim checks. :white_check_mark:
